description: This file defines the AutoScalingException class which represents exceptions specific to the AWS Auto Scaling service in PHP. It extends a general AWS exception class and is part of the AWS SDK's AutoScaling exception namespace.

classes.name: AutoScalingException
classes.description: A specific exception class for handling errors related to AWS Auto Scaling service interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherits constructor from AwsException; used for initializing the exception with error information.
